# Get Contacts From Input

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Gets contacts from the given input.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getContactsFrom(input: <#Variable (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getContactsFrom(input: Contact support@jellycuts.com)
~~~~
